svg.title: Subscriber outcome at renewal
svg.desc: Classification tree trained on 5,000 samples: 6 splits lead to 7 leaves, each coloured by its predicted class (renews, downgrades, cancels). Every node shows its sample count, Gini impurity and class mix; the True branch of each split is on the left.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Classification tree · 5,000 training samples · Gini impurity · depth 3
